rationale: The plan correctly recognizes the 3' tag-seq library, refuses any length normalization, and sends raw counts into DESeq2 with ~condition, apeglm/ashr shrinkage, padj thresholds at 0.05 and 0.1, and a note on n=3 limitations. QC covers library size, zero counts, VST PCA/clustering labeled by condition and metadata alignment, though the outlier policy is only 'flag' without a stated action. The low count filter is left to DESeq2 default independent filtering with no explicit floor tailored to the shallower per-gene counts of a tag library and no report of genes retained. Enrichment was not requested; the added WikiPathways step names a collection but omits version, ORA universe, and gene set size window. The report lacks software versions and an explicit count of genes tested.
